title: Scaffold React/Vite console, tokens, shell, and shared UI primitives
objective: Create a buildable TypeScript React/Vite operator console foundation that translates the Operations Ledger design tokens into CSS, renders the shared SiteFlow shell, and exposes route handoff modules for downstream feature work.
actions: Initialize npm package metadata for a private SiteFlow operator console using TypeScript, React, Vite, React Router, lucide-react, Vitest, Testing Library, jsdom, and Playwright dependencies.
Create Vite and TypeScript configs with strict TypeScript enabled and path aliases for app, components, features, domain, lib, styles, and test helpers.
Create index.html, src/main.tsx, src/app/App.tsx, and src/app/router.tsx so the first rendered screen is /projects inside the console shell.
Create route handoff modules for projects, deployments, and release that initially point to RoutePlaceholder so the scaffold can build before feature tasks replace their own modules.

Translate design-tokens.json and animation-tokens.json into src/styles/tokens.css with OKLCH variables, Inter/JetBrains Mono font stacks, 4/6/8px radii, semantic status variables, transition variables, and reduced-motion media query.

Create global and layout CSS for dense operations surfaces: 232px desktop nav, mobile single-column shell, sticky topbar, stable table overflow, panel spacing, focus states, and no decorative hero treatment.
Build shell components AppShell, SidebarNav, and Topbar with accessible nav labels and lucide icons for Projects, Deployments, Routes, Artifacts, Audit, and Settings.
Build shared UI primitives Button, IconButton, Panel, StatusPill, DataTable, and Timeline with accessible names, stable dimensions, semantic status text, and tokenized styles.
Create src/test/setup.ts with Testing Library jest-dom setup for downstream component tests.

files.purpose: npm scripts, dependencies, devDependencies, and private package metadata
lock dependency versions after npm install
React plugin, aliases, and Vitest environment
strict TS config for browser source
route table for all five target routes using feature route handoff modules
temporary route body for buildable scaffold

new_tests: Render AppShell with a memory router and assert the SiteFlow brand, primary nav labels, and /projects placeholder are visible.
Render StatusPill for success, warning, error, and info and assert each has visible text plus semantic CSS class.

criteria: package.json contains scripts named dev, build, test, test:watch, and test:e2e.
src/components/shell/SidebarNav.tsx renders SiteFlow and includes accessible nav links for Projects, Deployments, Routes, Artifacts, Audit, and Settings.
npm run build completes successfully after npm install.

risks: Initial dependency install may surface network or lockfile constraints because there is no existing package manager baseline.
Route handoff placeholders intentionally touch feature directories once; downstream tasks must replace only their own feature module.
Design tokens should be copied faithfully from design-ref and not replaced with a new palette.

execution.findings: Created Vite/React TypeScript console scaffold with tokenized shell, route handoff placeholders, shared UI primitives, and basic component tests. npm install/build/test passed; npm audit reports 5 moderate dependency advisories. Vite pinned to 5.x for Vitest type compatibility.
execution.tests_passed: npm install passed; npm run build passed; npm test -- --run passed (2 files, 5 tests).
